The '''Evasive-226-R''' was an advanced [[Individual field disruptor/Legends|individual field disruptor]] manufactured by [[Aeramaxis Technologies]]. It was more sophisticated than the company's [[Evasive-13 individual field disruptor|Evasive-13 model]], and was known to have been used by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Storm commando/Legends|Storm commandos]] and the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] [[Katarn Commandos|Page's Commandos]].<ref name="EGWT" />
